snippet.title: Kya: Dark Lineage | Playstation 2 Trailer
snippet.description:
The Trailer for Kya: Dark Lineage for Playstation 2

Join us on Discord! - https://discord.gg/cCR2z6e

My goal is to play every single Playstation 2 game Ever made... That's a whole lot of games, and it would make for a huge PS2 video library on YouTube! So why not subscribe and follow me with my average commentary through many many games!


Want to see the list of game I've played? Check out this Spreadsheet!
https://goo.gl/XUtQpB #PshychedPlays

I now have a Patreon page, if you wish to support my channel and my absurd quest, please visit my Patreon page! - https://www.patreon.com/Pshyched .
